function.name: dispatch
function.description: Accept a new independent background task. Several tasks can run concurrently; acceptance is not completion.

request.description: The requested work, including all relevant constraints. Its first sentence is shown to the user as the task title, so begin with the action in plain words and never refer to the user or this chat there.

for.description: The ID of the task whose open work request this settles, which makes the new task its subtask. Null for independent work.

question_id.description: The ID of the work question this settles, from that task's record. Null for independent work.

attachments.description: IDs of attached files this task needs: earlier files, and this message's files when it starts several tasks. When it starts one task, this message's files go with it automatically. Empty when there are none.

revises.description: The ID of the saved result this task changes. Null for anything else.

function.name: steer
function.description: Update one existing task while preserving its unrelated constraints.

run_id.description: The exact canonical task UUID from the task records.

interrupt.description: True for explicit replacement corrections, false for additive instructions. Runtime decides whether the active operation can be interrupted.

function.name: answer
function.description: Answer one task's exact current input question.

function.name: hold
function.description: Save a conversational question until the identified task outcome arrives; do not change task instructions.

function.name: show_result
function.description: Show one saved result in your reply, using its ID from saved_results. This starts no task.

function.name: remember
function.description: Save or correct one memory the user asked you to keep. This starts no task.

text.description: The complete memory, in a short third-person sentence.

about.description: Who it describes: the user, or the person they named.

replaces.description: The id of the saved memory this corrects. Null for a new memory.

function.name: forget
function.description: Delete one saved memory the user asked you to forget. Chat history is unchanged. This starts no task.

memory_id.description: The id of the saved memory.

function.name: stop
function.description: Request cancellation of only the identified task. Other tasks continue unchanged.
